gloss: wealth and poverty; rich and poor

definitions.gloss: wealth and poverty; the rich and the poor
definitions.explanation: Rich and poor taken together, almost always in talk of inequality. By far its most common use is {貧富|ひんぷ}の{差|さ} 'the gap between rich and poor'.

examples.japanese: {貧富|ひんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The gap between rich and poor widens.

examples.japanese: {貧富|ひんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくす⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is hard to eliminate the gap between rich and poor.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{貧富|ひんぷ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: At this school anyone can receive the same education, rich or poor.

notes:
A written-style word made of {貧|ひん} 'poor' and {富|ふ} 'rich'; everyday speech says ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{貧乏人|びんぼうにん} or talks about ⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧.
